designationHistory.indexText: National Wildlife Refuge Pingree, ND Arrowwood Wetland Management District Arrowwood Wetland Management District was established in 1961 as a breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Tewaukon Wetland Management District, About Us

review.note: Draft sentence was about Arrowwood Wetland Management District (1961), not Tewaukon WMD. No independent source for Tewaukon WMD's establishment year was found (the archived CCP was rate-limited). Check the Tewaukon CCP or the district narrative reports at the National Archives.
